messages:
sophia: Quick check — RC cut is scheduled for tomorrow 09:00 PT. Can we have console docs + SDK docs regen finished and staged by 06:30 PT? Need the version bump and changelog entries merged before cutoff. @ajay @lina status?

ajay: On it. Console docs PR open for the nav tweaks: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412. Waiting on one review. If it lands in the next 30m I can re-run the regen and push.

lina: SDK side: regen script works locally but the version bump PR is failing a flaky test in CI (integration-http). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/218. Fixing the test now, should be green within ~2 hours.

dave: I can take care of the staging deploy once both PRs are merged. Plan: merge -> `yarn docs:build && ./scripts/deploy-staging.sh` -> smoke-check. Will tag the staging build with the new version.

release-bot: :rotating_light: Reminder: cutoff window starts 2026-03-18 09:00 PT. Any changes not merged before that time should be queued for the next RC. Release checklist: https://go/release-checklist-rc16

sophia: Changelog nudge: please add 1-2 bullets under Unreleased for Console and SDK. Example entry format:
```
- console: fix settings nav behavior when users have multiple orgs (#412)
- sdk: bump to 1.8.0, fix header auth regression (#218)
```
Keep them short.

ajay: Added a minimal changelog snippet to the docs PR and requested review from @dave. If Lina's SDK PR is blocked, we'll still need the changelog merged so Dave can deploy a tag with the console changes.

lina: CI is green now — pushed a test fix and updated the bump. SDK PR updated: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/218. Also started a local `yarn docs:regen` against staging branch; logs look clean so far.

docs-bot: Docs regen finished on staging: http://staging.docs.redwood-inference.com/build-987 — no critical errors, 12 warnings (mostly anchors).

dave: Perfect. I'll wait until both PRs are merged and the changelog is in. Targeting deploy at 06:30 PT per Sophia. If something blocks, fallback is: deploy previous tag and delay RC by 1 hour.

sophia: Thanks — quick checklist for the channel (please `done` when complete):
1) merge docs PR (ajay)
2) merge SDK PR (lina)
3) add changelog bullets (any)
4) confirm staging build (docs-bot)
5) tag & deploy staging (dave)

If any step looks risky, call it out here now so we can adjust the cutoff.

ajay: Merged docs PR — changelog updated.

lina: SDK PR merged and CI green — bump committed.

docs-bot: Staging build passed post-merge: http://staging.docs.redwood-inference.com/build-990 — 0 errors.

dave: Deploy kicked off. Will report back when smoke checks finish.

sophia: Awesome, thanks everyone. Ping here when smoke is green and I'll give final go for RC cut.

dave: Smoke checks all green. Staging looks good. Tagging for RC now. :tada:

sophia: Done — proceeding with RC cut. Good job, team.
